content: Hello! You've reached Payroll Support. How can I assist you with your payment or employment details today?
Hi, I just want to check if my salary for June was deposited. I usually get paid via direct deposit but I haven't seen anything arrive yet.
Certainly, I can help with that. For verification, I see that your employee ID is 84217 and your direct deposit is set to account ending in 1532 at Greenfield Bank, correct?
Yes, that's right. My name is Marissa Chen, just to confirm. I'm worried because I need the funds cleared before June 30th for my rent.

Thank you, Marissa. According to our records, your June payroll in the amount of $2,480.50 was processed via ACH transfer (Ref: GF-DEP-50621) on June 27th at 9:08 AM. It should post to your account by end of business today.
Great, is there any hold or reason it could be delayed? I use marissachen@brightmail.com for payroll notifications, but I haven't received anything.

No holds are showing at this time. Sometimes, notifications from payroll@companypayroll.com get caught in spam, please check that folder. If you don't see the $2,480.50 in account 1532 by 5 PM, please call our urgent line at (800) 555-2901 referencing your employee ID 84217 for immediate assistance.
Thanks for confirming all the details. I'll keep an eye on my account today.
You're welcome, Marissa. If the funds aren't available by 5 PM, reach out right away so we can escalate. Your timely access to payroll is our priority.
